Examining its post-training recipe and what local inference really costs.","excerptZh":"围绕Liquid AI 8月4日的新模型，解读领域教师、在线蒸馏与Agent强化学习，并讨论端侧部署的真实成本和验收方法。","tags":["LFM2.5","Small Models","On-Device AI","Post-Training"],"readTime":"6 min","sections":[{"heading":{"en":"The news: a compact agentic release","zh":"新闻焦点：面向端侧的Agent模型"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B on August 4, together with base and post-trained checkpoints. The announcement targets local agents rather than only short chat answers. Its model card describes a text model with roughly 2.69B parameters, a 128K-class context window, and a hybrid backbone with short-convolution and grouped-query-attention blocks.","zh":"Liquid AI于8月4日发布LFM2.5-2.6B，同时提供基础模型和后训练版本。发布重点是本地Agent，而不只是简短聊天。模型卡描述的是一个约2.69B参数的文本模型，具有128K级上下文，骨干结合短卷积与分组查询注意力模块。"},{"en":"This is a useful contrast to the large MoEs discussed in July: fitting useful behavior into a smaller model changes where computation can happen. It does not establish that the model can replace a frontier service on arbitrary tasks. Local deployment makes workload selection more important, not less.","zh":"它与七月讨论的大型MoE形成了有用的对照：把实用能力放进更小的模型，会改变计算能够发生的位置。但这不意味着它能在任意任务上替代前沿云端服务。选择适合的工作负载，反而因此变得更加重要。"}],"sources":[1,2]},{"heading":{"en":"The post-training recipe is the main story","zh":"技术重点：后训练配方比参数量更值得研究"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"The launch describes supervised fine-tuning, teacher specialization, Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. Domain-specific teachers supervise a student's own rollouts, followed by training in agent environments. The intended progression is from knowing response formats to navigating the states created by tool use.","zh":"公告介绍了监督微调、教师专业化、多领域在线策略蒸馏，以及Agent强化学习的组合。领域教师对学生自身生成的轨迹提供监督，随后在Agent环境中训练。其目标是从掌握回答格式，走向能够处理工具调用后不断变化的环境状态。"},{"en":"The general lesson is that a small model needs experience with its own mistakes. A static demonstration may show a successful API call but never teach recovery from an empty result or malformed argument. When evaluating a candidate, include those intermediate failures explicitly, rather than testing only ideal examples.","zh":"这一思路的普遍启发是：小模型需要接触自身会犯的错误。一条静态示范也许展示了成功的API调用，却没有教会它如何处理空结果或参数错误。评估候选模型时，应把这些中间故障显式加入测试，而不是只测试理想路径。"}],"sources":[1]},{"heading":{"en":"Local inference has a different bill, not no bill","zh":"部署账本：本地推理改变成本结构，不会让成本消失"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Removing a per-token API fee leaves device purchase, energy, memory pressure, thermal throttling, and maintenance. For an always-on assistant, measure sustained throughput after the device warms up, time to first token under realistic prompt lengths, and interference with foreground applications. A short peak-speed demonstration is insufficient.","zh":"没有按token支付的API费用之后，仍然存在硬件购置、电力、内存压力、热降频和维护成本。对常驻助手，应测设备升温后的持续吞吐、真实提示长度下的首token延迟，以及它对前台应用的影响。短时间峰值速度不足以说明长期体验。"},{"en":"Quantization also deserves task-level validation. A compact checkpoint that still writes fluent text may have become less reliable at exact tool names, argument types, or multi-turn state tracking. Compare a higher-precision reference with the intended deployment format on identical traces. Keep model quality and runtime performance as separate measurements.","zh":"量化也需要任务级验证。一个仍然能流畅写作的低精度模型，可能在精确工具名称、参数类型或多轮状态跟踪上已经变差。应使用相同轨迹，对比较高精度参考版本与实际部署格式，并把模型质量和运行时性能分别记录。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Start with a narrow local workflow","zh":"落地建议：从范围有限的本地工作流开始"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"A sensible pilot is a local document organizer: classify a file, propose a structured action, and validate that action before applying it. Track incorrect tool calls and abstentions as well as successes. Only add a cloud fallback if the product requires it, and make that boundary visible to users; local weights alone do not guarantee that tools or telemetry keep all data on-device.","zh":"一个合适的试点是本地文档整理：分类文件、提出结构化操作，再验证操作是否符合要求。除了成功案例，也记录错误工具调用和无法完成的情况。只有产品需要时才加入云端回退，并让用户明确知道这条边界；模型权重在本地，并不保证工具和遥测也会把所有数据留在设备上。"}]}],"sources":[{"title":"Liquid AI — LFM2.5-2.6B launch and training recipe","date":"2026-08-04","url":"https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-2-6b"},{"title":"Liquid AI — LFM2.5-2.6B model card","date":"Release documentation; living model card","url":"https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B"},{"title":"LFM2 Technical Report — architecture background, not the August release","date":"2025-11-28","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23404"}]}}],["$L7"],"$L8"]}],{},null,false,null]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,null],"$La",false]],"m":"$undefined","G":["$b",["$Lc"]],"S":true,"h":null,"s":"$undefined","l":"$undefined","p":"$undefined","d":"$undefined","b":"ekZJX53BQfdyxE9HisC-1"}
